en-US.title: The Talk Ahead
en-US.subtitle: Communication Skills Practice
en-US.description:
The Talk Ahead helps new managers practice the workplace conversations that are hardest to say out loud.

Bring a real conversation or choose a guided scenario. Rehearse it by voice with a realistic AI colleague, meet believable resistance, and get a concise debrief grounded in what you actually said.

PRACTICE BEFORE IT COUNTS
• Rehearse difficult feedback, boundaries, underperformance, and conflict
• Prepare for conversations with former peers and direct reports
• Practice speaking clearly without becoming harsh
• Build confidence through private, repeatable rehearsal

LEARN FROM THE MOMENTS THAT MATTER
• See where you clarified—or softened—the standard
• Rewind an important moment and try a different approach
• Pressure-test the same situation against a different reaction
• Leave with a concise Before You Go In plan

BUILT FOR REAL CONVERSATIONS
The Talk Ahead does not hand you a perfect script. It helps you remain clear, curious, and accountable when the conversation gets uncomfortable.

Your sessions are private, and recorded audio is not retained after transcription.
